parse.title: Hammer Giantess (Creation)
parse.text:
Overview

Hammer Giantess (Creation) is a MythicalMythical unit. She is only obtainable through evolving Hammer Giantess.

Evolving

Hammer Giantess (Creation) can be evolved from Hammer Giantess with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Hammer Giantess
x12 Demonic Chalice
x12 Demonic Horn
x6 Fairy Petals
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x3 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Hammer Giantess (Creation)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
